== mint-live.cfg
append boot=casper initrd=/casper/initrd.lz uuid=6e72f523-dc09-4880-8910-93ffa64401c5 username=mint hostname=mint quiet splash keyboard-configuration/layoutcode=be locale=nl_BE.UTF-8 belgian.keyboard=be belgian.decimal=period --
append boot=casper initrd=/casper/initrd.lz uuid=6e72f523-dc09-4880-8910-93ffa64401c5 username=mint hostname=mint quiet splash keyboard-configuration/layoutcode=be locale=nl_BE.UTF-8 belgian.keyboard=be belgian.decimal=comma --
append boot=casper initrd=/casper/initrd.lz uuid=6e72f523-dc09-4880-8910-93ffa64401c5 username=mint hostname=mint quiet splash keyboard-configuration/layoutcode=be locale=fr_BE.UTF-8 belgian.keyboard=be belgian.decimal=period --
append boot=casper initrd=/casper/initrd.lz uuid=6e72f523-dc09-4880-8910-93ffa64401c5 username=mint hostname=mint quiet splash keyboard-configuration/layoutcode=be locale=fr_BE.UTF-8 belgian.keyboard=be belgian.decimal=comma --
append boot=casper initrd=/casper/initrd.lz uuid=6e72f523-dc09-4880-8910-93ffa64401c5 username=mint hostname=mint quiet splash keyboard-configuration/layoutcode=be locale=de_BE.UTF-8 belgian.keyboard=be belgian.decimal=period --
append boot=casper initrd=/casper/initrd.lz uuid=6e72f523-dc09-4880-8910-93ffa64401c5 username=mint hostname=mint quiet splash keyboard-configuration/layoutcode=be locale=de_BE.UTF-8 belgian.keyboard=be belgian.decimal=comma --
append boot=casper initrd=/casper/initrd.lz uuid=6e72f523-dc09-4880-8910-93ffa64401c5 username=mint hostname=mint quiet splash keyboard-configuration/layoutcode=de locale=de_BE.UTF-8 belgian.keyboard=de --
append boot=casper initrd=/casper/initrd.lz uuid=6e72f523-dc09-4880-8910-93ffa64401c5 username=mint hostname=mint quiet splash keyboard-configuration/layoutcode=be locale=en_US.UTF-8 belgian.keyboard=be belgian.decimal=period belgian.formats=be --
append boot=casper initrd=/casper/initrd.lz uuid=6e72f523-dc09-4880-8910-93ffa64401c5 username=mint hostname=mint quiet splash keyboard-configuration/layoutcode=be locale=en_US.UTF-8 belgian.keyboard=be belgian.decimal=comma belgian.formats=be --
append boot=casper initrd=/casper/initrd.lz uuid=6e72f523-dc09-4880-8910-93ffa64401c5 username=mint hostname=mint quiet splash keyboard-configuration/layoutcode=de locale=en_US.UTF-8 belgian.keyboard=de belgian.formats=be --
label compat
menu label Start Linux Mint in compatibility mode
linux /casper/vmlinuz
append boot=casper initrd=/casper/initrd.lz uuid=6e72f523-dc09-4880-8910-93ffa64401c5 username=mint hostname=mint noapic noacpi nosplash irqpoll nomodeset keyboard-configuration/layoutcode=be locale=nl_BE.UTF-8 belgian.keyboard=be belgian.decimal=period --
label oem
menu label OEM install (for manufacturers)
linux /casper/vmlinuz
append oem-config/enable=true only-ubiquity boot=casper initrd=/casper/initrd.lz uuid=6e72f523-dc09-4880-8910-93ffa64401c5 username=mint hostname=mint quiet splash keyboard-configuration/layoutcode=be locale=nl_BE.UTF-8 belgian.keyboard=be belgian.decimal=period --
label hdt
menu label Hardware Detection
label local
menu label Boot from local drive
label memtest
menu label Memory test
linux /boot/memtest.bin
